mechanism: Budesonide (corticosteroid) can cause sodium retention and hypokalemia, while torsemide causes potassium and magnesium wasting, compounding electrolyte depletion risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium, magnesium, and sodium levels regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing diuretic; monitor blood pressure for budesonide-induced hypertension.
